_comment: neural-audio-bench base configuration. Authoritative defaults for every parameter: the engine fails fast if no config is provided — there are no compiled-in fallbacks. Layering: base.json <- experiment preset <- CLI overrides. Paths are relative to this file's directory.

contention._contention_levels_comment: Dimension A values are requested conventional source-track counts. The neural track and 12 bus/return tracks are always active; only 23 conventional source slots exist, so requested levels 24 and 36 both map to 23 and are retained for paper compatibility.
contention._use_system_au_comment: true = Dimension A uses real macOS system AUs (AUParametricEQ, AUDynamicsProcessor, etc.); false = lightweight custom DSP (biquad EQ, compressor, reverb, delay)

backends._comment: Which backends to test. Set false to skip. Backends unavailable in a selected engine binary are logged and skipped.

model_sizes._comment: Which model sizes to benchmark. Set false to skip.
